upsert.center: Colorado State University Veterinary Teaching Hospital / Flint Animal Cancer Center
upsert.contacts: Colorado State University Flint Animal Cancer Center clinical trials service — (970) 297-4001
upsert.notes: Canonical CSU record for Clinical Testing of Canine T cells Engineered to Target Osteosarcoma and Soft Tissue Sarcoma in Combination with Oral Immunotherapy. Current CSU clinical-trials listing confirms enrollment. The earlier Tufts-labeled alias was incorrect and is not used as a separate record.

upsert.funding: Owners pay the initial exam and screening. After enrollment, Auburn states the remainder of the trial is funded for up to two months, including tumor biopsy, rechecks, bloodwork and chemotherapy.
upsert.notes: Current Auburn ongoing palbociclib oncology trial for dogs with measurable mammary carcinoma, melanoma, squamous cell carcinoma, histiocytic sarcoma or AGASACA. Prior cancer treatment is allowed if disease is progressing at enrollment.
